title: netWanted * MAX_BPS is evaluated before the principal cap, so the market override panics on the idiomatic type(uint256).max request while the base default answers it
description: The market override computes Math.ceilDiv(netWanted * MAX_BPS, denominator) BEFORE capping netWanted against available principal, so the multiplication overflows and reverts with a bare Panic(0x11). The base default caps first and returns the capped principal. Two implementations of ONE published interface member therefore diverge on the standard 'give me everything' sentinel.
impact: A consumer switching between the two strategies behind one IYieldStrategy interface gets a revert from one and an answer from the other for the same idiomatic input. Direct at type(uint256).max returns the capped principal (1000e18, no revert); market reverts Panic(0x11). Asserted boundary: netWanted > 11579208923731619542357098500868790785326998466564056403945758400791312963 reverts; the boundary value itself returns the capped principal. Aggravating: story-050 criterion 9 explicitly demanded a NEIGHBOURING division edge be distinguishable from a bare Panic(0x12) — this ships a bare Panic(0x11) on a MORE plausible input.
attackPath: A consumer requests a full exit using the idiomatic type(uint256).max sentinel.
Against ERC4626YieldStrategy (base preview) it receives the capped principal.
Against ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy the same call reverts with a bare Panic(0x11).
The consumer cannot write one code path against the interface.
recommendation: One line: apply Math.min(netWanted, availablePrincipal) before the gross-up, matching the base's cap-first ordering.
lineCitationNote: CITATION DRIFT CORRECTED: dedup and the classifier cite ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy.sol:174 for the Math.ceilDiv(netWanted * MAX_BPS, denominator) gross-up. At cdd0743 that statement is on LINE 176 (:174 is the closing brace of the denominator == 0 guard). Function, expression and mechanism are all correct; only the line number was off by two.
escalationTrigger: None realistic — no asset path. Stays Low even under WATCH-17-03.
severityNote: Held at Low rather than QA (severity-auditor concurs): interface-member divergence on the idiomatic max-withdrawal sentinel is a spec defect, not an absurd-input filter case. Borderline => do not downgrade.
